[EN] Unfortunately, the kingdom isn't wholly united. There are some poporis, such as the {@LinkCreature:23#20#elin witches} who use their power for themselves, not for nature.

They attacked our villages recently. You're going to be our retribution.
[ES] Desafortunadamente, el reino no está completamente unido. Hay algunos poporis, como las {@LinkCreature:23#20#elin witches} que usan su poder para sí mismos, no para la naturaleza.

Atacaron nuestras aldeas recientemente. Vas a ser nuestra retribución.

[EN] Thanks to you, those rogues are greatly weakened. That will help us enormously.Thanks, .
[ES] Gracias a ti, esos rufianes están muy debilitados. Eso nos ayudará enormemente. Gracias, .
